info.title: Vercel REST API & SDK
info.description: The [`@vercel/sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vercel/sdk) is a type-safe Typescript SDK that allows you to access the resources and methods of the Vercel REST API. Learn how to [install it](https://vercel.com/docs/rest-api/sdk#installing-vercel-sdk) and [authenticate](https://vercel.com/docs/rest-api/sdk#authentication) with a Vercel access token.

get.description: Retrieves information related to the currently authenticated User.

403.description: You do not have permission to access this resource.

get.description: Retrieves a list of domains registered for the authenticated user or team. By default it returns the last 20 domains if no limit is provided.

200.description: Successful response retrieving a list of domains.

boughtAt.description: If it was purchased through Vercel, the timestamp in milliseconds when it was purchased.

createdAt.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when the domain was created in the registry.

creator.description: An object containing information of the domain creator, including the user's id, username, and email.

customNameservers.description: A list of custom nameservers for the domain to point to. Only applies to domains purchased with Vercel.

echMode.description: Whether the domain is enrolled in Encrypted Client Hello. `auto` leaves the decision to Vercel, `enabled` always enrolls, and `disabled` never enrolls and opts out of automatic enrollment.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp in milliseconds at which the domain is set to expire. null if not bought with Vercel.

id.description: The unique identifier of the domain.

intendedNameservers.description: A list of the intended nameservers for the domain to point to Vercel DNS.

nameservers.description: A list of the current nameservers of the domain.

renew.description: Indicates whether the domain is set to automatically renew.

serviceType.description: The type of service the domain is handled by. `external` if the DNS is externally handled, `zeit.world` if handled with Vercel, or `na` if the service is not available.

transferredAt.description: Timestamp in milliseconds at which the domain was successfully transferred into Vercel. `null` if the transfer is still processing or was never transferred in.

transferStartedAt.description: If transferred into Vercel, timestamp in milliseconds when the domain transfer was initiated.

verified.description: If the domain has the ownership verified.

400.description: One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

403.description: You do not have permission to access this resource.

parameters.description: Maximum number of domains to list from a request.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Get domains created before this JavaScript timestamp.

canOptOut.description: Whether this user can cancel their optional Account Update flow.

orphanSsoTeam.description: Orphans only: the team whose Directory Sync invite SSO sign-in redeems for a managed account once Update Account is complete.

accountUpdateContext.description: Context for the Update Account screen. Present only when `isAccountUpdateRequired` is true. `managedTeams` is empty for orphan mode (user matches an EMU domain but is not on the team). When the teams the user must complete Update Account for include an organization's backing team, that team is listed as the organization, followed by the organization's Enterprise Managed root and child teams the user is a member of, including through Directory Sync group mappings.
